finding.text: audit.mjs builds the ask id by slugging the title without lowercasing it (`ask.title?.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-')`), so "Memory: …" becomes "-emory-…" and never matches the lowercase `id` that the ledger's later status lines use. Status updates are never merged into the ask, so every count in audit.json is wrong. Lowercase the title, or key on `ask.id`. Done that way, there are about 70 asks: 40 landed, 16 queued, 5 stalled, 3 parked, 3 dropped, 3 building.

report.md's headline numbers don't match the script's own output. The report says "259 total, 215 landed (83%)"; audit.json says `total_asks: 105, landed: 0`. 258 is the ledger's line count, not its ask count. Rule 7 says numbers are computed, and this report's numbers weren't taken from the script.
audit.mjs:159 computes `landed` as `unbuilt.filter(a => a.status === 'landed')`, which is always 0 because `unbuilt` only holds stalled/dropped/parked asks.

Deliverable 1 isn't met for tasks. audit.mjs:44 `parseTasks()` walks every task.jsonl, but its result is never written to the output. About 51 task dirs from 09-30 to 10-07 have no `landed_at`, and none of them appear. There is also no "stopped / never started / stale" state anywhere, only landed vs building.

Deliverable 2 asked for about 15 asks and got 5, and one of the 5 is "Unnamed (empty title, 6 entries)", which is an artifact of bug 1: those lines are status updates, not asks. Fixing the merge shows 16 queued asks that never started (e.g. "Proposals: a Proposal class…", "Monitor: a Playwright agent on main…", "Now card: topics as nested sub-cards from refined prompts") plus 5 stalled ones ("Grip…", "Inbox: priority 50+…", "Framework home: grids without voids…"). Those are exactly what the owner asked to see.

Deliverable 3 says prompt refinement "runs live on owner prompts via the Council system (`Server/council.mjs`)", but council.mjs never mentions refine. The evidence that does exist is `ai2/faces.js` importing `prompt_modes` from `ext/Refine/prompt-card.js` and rendering `it.refined`. Say that, and note that the ask "Prompts: each owner prompt becomes a refined Inbox card" was dropped and the "Now card … from refined prompts" ask is still queued. The owner's question was whether this got built, and the honest answer is "partly".

Deliverable 4 claims "No tasks were stopped due to usage wall or error" without citing a source. The brief points to the Servex logs and log.jsonl, and nothing shows they were read. It also contradicts itself: "5 entries … stalled", then "three later resumed", then "one remains stalled", while the corrected ledger shows 5 still stalled. If the logs weren't searched, the answer should say "unknown".

The report's closing line "The asks ledger is clean" isn't supported. The ledger itself carries "card corrected: … does not exist" lines, and the report's own "Unnamed" entry shows the data was misread.
The task never landed. task.jsonl has only the assign line, with no progress lines and no `landed_at`, so the board shows it as in flight. finish-task was required.

audit.mjs:7 hardcodes `C:\\Code\\lew42\\monorepo` as the repo root, so the script reads the main tree rather than the worktree it ran in (qf-6). Resolve the root from `import.meta.url` instead (four `..` up).

A simpler approach: one reduce over asks.jsonl keyed on `id ?? slug(title)`, plus one pass over task.jsonl files, gives every number the report needs. It would fit in about 40 lines and would remove the hand-written figures.
report.md is longer than one screen, and its "Script & Data" section restates file names instead of linking them.
